rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables AI agents to launch and manage system processes with comprehensive security controls. Features six layers of security validation including executable allowlists, argument validation, environment sanitization, and resource limits. Provides twelve tools for process launching, real-time resource monitoring (CPU, memory, I/O), output capture, service orchestration with auto-restart, and process grouping for pipelines.
